caption:
Retirees got a rare win: the 2027 COLA is 3.6%, while Medicare Part B rises 3.2%. 🧓
It's the first time since 2023 the premium increase is smaller than the raise.
The Part B jump is $6.50 a month, to $209.40.
Do the retirees in your life track this?
first_comment: Anyone you know on Social Security? Do they check the Part B number each year?
